messages:
Maria: Heads up team 1 NebulaPay RFP just arrived. They require private/onprem deployment with customermanaged HSM (Thales or Azure HSM), VPC peering, and a 3week POC. Attached: security questionnaire + sample architecture sheet https://drive.google.com/nebulapay-secQ1
Devin: I can own the POC run. Need: (a) target QPS & typical prompt lengths, (b) labeled eval set for quality checks, (c) acceptance criteria. Also: can we give them a 3week Dedicated trial instead of full Private to speed onboarding? @Paul any cost guidance?
Paul: Two recommended offers: 1) Hosted Dedicated trial (temporary reserved GPU pool, no infra install)  Estimated 3week cost: ~$9.5k (equiv. 1x A40 pool) with trial credit. 2) Private/onprem PoC  Onetime setup & licensing estimate: ~$52k + monthly infra (varies). HSM integration professional services estimate: $710k depending on vendor. Ill put line items in the RFP response.
Ali: SE notes for RFI: Private supports customerowned KMS via keywrap/KMIP and can integrate with Thales/AKV. Thales older firmware (prev3.x) needs an extra keywrap shim; call that out. For Dedicated (hosted) we can accept customer keys only if network peering (VPN/PrivateLink) is arranged and approved by SecOps. Will include supported KMS flows and a sample key rotation runbook.
Sarah: Ill take the security questionnaire. Quick flags: SOC2 Type II  yes; ISO27001  yes; FedRAMP High  no. Data residency: supported in Private; hosted clusters can be pinned to region but not onprem. Audit logging & key rotation: we provide logs + rotation APIs. Ill upload completed spreadsheet by EOD and highlight exceptions.
Devin: Proposed PoC acceptance criteria (suggested): 1) 99th percentile latency <= 200ms at 800 qps for 04k token sequences; 2) Quality: >= 94% pass on 400 labeled prompts (semantic agreement); 3) KV cache warmup verified; 4) Endtoend KMS key wrap and rotate tested with sample key. Sound reasonable?
Maria: NebulaPay expects kickoff in ~10 business days and RFI back by Friday COB. We should propose both tracks (Dedicated trial or Private) and recommend Private for compliance but Dedicated to shorten sales cycle.
Ali: Ops note  include these test scripts in attachments: wrk wrapper for load, kv warmup script, and a simple smoke curl. Example smoke test: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-transformer-1","input":"test ping"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate
```
Ill attach network topology diagram and an HSM compatibility checklist.
Paul: Ill draft pricing table with: usage hosted rates, Dedicated 1month commit pricing, Private setup & recurring license, and professional services for HSM. Ill call out a PoC discount line and estimated peering/VPN engineering hours.
Maria: Legal question  can we accept NebulaPays standard DPA with our usual minor revisions? @LegalBot please advise.
[LegalBot]: Flag  DPA requires review; SLA section will need to be negotiated for Private deployments. Recommending Legal take the RFI doc.
Sarah: Action items consolidated: Ali -> HSM firmware checklist + network diagram; Devin -> PoC plan, load scripts, eval harness; Paul -> pricing & line items; Sarah -> sec questionnaire completed; Maria -> assemble RFI and submit draft by Thu. Ive created a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/nebulapay-rfp-2
Maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
[upload-bot]: NebulaPay_RFI_Supplement_v1.xlsx uploaded to shared folder (link above)
